svg.title: One mapped PointCloud output of the Lidar generic core model
svg.desc: Left, the tensors of one mapped PointCloud output with their shapes: Counts [1]; Coordinates [3, Nmax] as three stacked rows x, y, z, component-first; Intensity, TimeOffsetNs and Flags [Nmax] as single rows; HitNormal [Nmax, 3] as Nmax groups of three adjacent cells, point-first. In every per-point row the leading range [0, Counts[0]) is shaded delivered and the remainder up to Nmax is hatched: it holds whatever it held before. One Flags byte is magnified: bit 6 (0x40) marks a real return, bit 5 (0x20) a return that belongs to the scan after the one the frame started in. Right, the CPU-resident params that travel beside the tensors.
svg.text: component-first: all x, then all y, then all z
point-first: one point's x, y, z adjacent
bit 5, 0x20: belongs to the next scan
because bit 5 can be set on a real return as well.
Every other requested channel follows the same rule: EmitterId, ChannelId, TickId, EchoId, TickState and MaterialId are [Nmax];
ObjectId [Nmax, 4] and Velocity [Nmax, 3] are point-first like HitNormal.
up to Nmax: holds whatever it held before; never read it
Scalars and small vectors that describe the frame,
readable the moment the output is mapped.
the shaping values in force for this frame.
